verdicts.reason: A squeezes the quote into a narrow right column, so it breaks into one- and two-word lines ('little', 'bitter,'). The attribution floats off on its own to the left of the quote, and the logo has shrunk to an unreadable speck near the top. B stacks things sensibly for a tall format and keeps the logo intact. However, its attribution is indented and doesn't line up with the quote's left edge. The attribution is also jammed right under the quote and runs into the edge of the circle, and there's a large empty band between the quote mark and the quote.
